neubauer.titolo: Garanzie intertemporali di liberta': la Vorwirkung delle quantita' di emissioni ammesse oggi
neubauer.testo: Fundamental rights, as intertemporal guarantees of freedom, protect against a one-sided offloading of the greenhouse gas reduction burden onto the future: emission amounts allowed today have an advance interference-like effect, because whatever is allowed now makes later and more drastic restrictions of almost every exercise of freedom unavoidable.

neubauer.titolo: Il percorso di riduzione dopo il 2030: avviare per tempo la transizione, con indicazioni trasparenti
neubauer.testo: Respecting future freedom requires initiating the transition to climate neutrality in good time: transparent specifications for the reduction pathway after the current target period must be formulated early, conveying developmental urgency and planning certainty.

neubauer.titolo: Il budget di carbonio residuo: il legislatore si e' vincolato al limite di temperatura concordato
neubauer.testo: Article 20a of the Basic Law is a justiciable climate mandate: the legislature has specified it through the Paris temperature limit of well below 2 degrees and preferably 1.5 degrees Celsius, which binds later legislation; that limit can be translated into a remaining national carbon dioxide budget, estimated by the German Advisory Council on the Environment, to be respected with special care under scientific uncertainty.

neubauer.titolo: Dimensione internazionale ed equita' fra gli Stati: nessuna scusa dalle emissioni altrui
neubauer.testo: The global nature of warming does not invalidate the obligation to take climate action: the State may not evade responsibility by pointing to other States' emissions and must not create incentives that undermine mutual trust.

neubauer.titolo: Dovere oggettivo verso le generazioni future (art. 20a GG): i posteri non sono ancora titolari di diritti
neubauer.testo: Future generations, whether as a whole or as people not yet born, do not yet carry fundamental rights in the present; the State's duty towards them is solely objective, under the mandate to protect the natural foundations of life and to spread environmental burdens fairly between generations.

neubauer.titolo: Dovere di protezione di vita e salute (art. 2(2) GG) contro i rischi del clima: esiste, ma non e' violato
neubauer.testo: The State's duty to protect life and physical integrity under Article 2(2) of the Basic Law also covers the dangers of climate change, such as heat waves, floods and hurricanes, through internationally embedded mitigation and through adaptation; the legislature has a wide margin, and the duty is breached only if protective measures are entirely lacking or manifestly unsuitable, which the Court did not find.

neubauer.titolo: Ammissibilita' e legittimazione: i singoli sono colpiti anche se il rischio riguarda tutti; le associazioni no; i ricorrenti all'estero si'
neubauer.testo: A future risk founds present, individual and direct affectedness when it is irreversibly built into current law: the complainants have standing although almost everyone will be affected, because a constitutional complaint is not an actio popularis; they do not assert rights of future generations; complainants living abroad have standing, environmental associations do not.

future-generations.titolo: Conexidad: la tutela individuale e' ammessa quando il danno all'ambiente minaccia vita, salute, acqua e dignita' di ricorrenti identificabili
future-generations.testo: The right to a healthy environment is collective, yet where its impairment threatens the life, health, water and dignity of identifiable claimants, the individual remedy is exceptionally admissible despite the availability of a collective action.

future-generations.titolo: I diritti delle generazioni future come obbligo di non fare che limita la liberta' dei presenti
future-generations.testo: The environmental rights of future generations, founded on the ethical duty of solidarity of the species and the intrinsic value of nature, constitute a binding obligation of non-action that limits the freedom of present generations.

future-generations.titolo: L'Amazzonia colombiana soggetto di diritti, per un criterio ecocentrico-antropico
future-generations.testo: To protect an ecosystem vital for the global future, the entire rainforest biome is recognised as an entity subject of rights to protection, conservation, maintenance and restoration by the State and its territorial entities; environmental protection transcends the anthropocentric perspective in favour of an ecocentric-anthropic criterion that places the human being on a par with the ecosystem.
future-generations.esclusione_di_provenienza: Non il fiume Atrato (Corte Constitucional, T-622/2016) ne' gli altri fiumi, paramos o ecosistemi dichiarati soggetti di diritti da altre corti: una pagina che riconosce diritti a un altro ecosistema non riprende questa sentenza, salvo che la nomini o ne riprenda l'Amazzonia.

future-generations.titolo: Rimedio strutturale e partecipato: piano d'azione e patto intergenerazionale per l'Amazzonia (PIVAC)
future-generations.testo: The Court orders the Presidency and the ministries to formulate, within fixed deadlines and with the participation of the claimants, the affected communities and scientific bodies, an action plan and an intergenerational pact for the life of the Colombian Amazon, and orders the Amazonian municipalities to update their land-use plans: a structural and participatory remedy whose compliance the courts supervise.

future-generations.titolo: La deforestazione dell'Amazzonia, causa di cambiamento climatico, minaccia i diritti dei ricorrenti presenti e futuri
future-generations.testo: Deforestation of the Amazon, by releasing carbon dioxide and altering water and soil, contributes to climate change and causes imminent and serious harm to the fundamental rights to life, health and water of the claimants, present and future; the State's failure to curb it violates those rights.
